meta_description:
5,766 likes, 25 comments - namitathapar on October 14, 2026: "Enjoyed meeting Harsh & Tanvi from Bear House @bearhouseindia (Season 4) & Arun from Janitri @janitri_for_hospitals (Season 2). Sharing some updates on my dear founders from @sharktank.india 

A 450 CR ARR powerhouse, Bear House makes me proud. I wear their flannel shirts a lot as I love the class & comfort. With 15000 sku, 32 EBO, 500 plus offline presence… offline went from 0% to 50% of sales in one year. They are expanding into footwear, fragrances & bags. Loving their new campaign that uses only one glass of water in each denim. 

Arun is doing such important work at Janitri. I’m so happy to state that this innovative healthcare company focusing on high risk pregnancy has now got 15 patents ! I’m loving their new launch, Navam Temp Live, smart fever patch for babies.".
